scenarios.expected: Two decision rows; readable agenda, Tomorrow plan, synthetic evidence and activity.
No invented obligations; quiet empty Needs you state with zero count and truthful agenda.
Visible stale source and fixed timestamps; approval unavailable until the demo is reset to current evidence.
Explain sample mail source is disconnected; no approval can simulate completion.
Inspection-only pending fixture, disabled approval; no artificial typing delay.
Explicit simulated failure; no successful receipt; provide review/reset as the available local recovery.
Visibly unknown simulated outcome; no retry-send button or completion claim.
Long subject, unbroken identifier and non-ASCII display name wrap at 320px without concealing address or actions.
Two candidate people; require selection before an approval proposal. No guessed recipient.
A proposal revision change invalidates prior simulated approval; version 2 never silently replaces approved version 3.
Details readable; approve/reject blocked; explicit paused label; reset restores initial fixtures.

reset_contract.theme: May preserve a non-sensitive appearance preference; must be documented and tested

fixture_rules: No secrets, real accounts, health or financial records.
All timestamps fixed; no relative time based on wall clock.
Attachment metadata is illustrative; no real attachment supplied.
